business.title: There Are Likely More Spies at AI Companies, Says Security Executive Lisa Thiergart
business.description: Other countries likely haven’t yet stolen AI models from leading U.S. companies—but only for a lack of trying, said Lisa Thiergart, co-founder and CEO of Security Level 5, a startup that works with AI companies and the intelligence community to secure AI data centers. “If a nation state really wanted to steal the weights right now, they could. However, I think that they have cheaper ways to get what they need,” she said on the latest episode of AI Deep Dive. (The full episode is available here.)
